Fashion · Personal style

A wardrobe that feels like you

Build around the pieces you reach for, again and again.

By The Offbeat Edit · Culture Issue · 1 min read

Notice what works

Personal style often begins with noticing what already works. The jacket you always take, the shoes you can walk in, and the colour that makes an ordinary day feel brighter are useful clues.

Try a new combination

Choose a few favourites and try them in unfamiliar combinations. Change a proportion, repeat a colour, or add one textured layer. Photograph the combinations you want to remember.

Make a considered choice

Before buying something new, imagine how it fits into three outfits you already wear. Taking care of your clothes and making considered repairs can be part of the same creative process.

Build around the pieces you reach for, again and again.
